title: Forgone gains from dishonest reports
hook: Two stated cases: explore the opportunity total behind a forgone fraction.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the opportunity total behind a forgone fraction affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the opportunity total behind a forgone fraction in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
